item.title: 【HD Live Performances】BDRiP - AFTERSCHOOL First Japan Tour 2012 -PLAYGIRLZ- (1080p HD)
item.description:
AFTERSCHOOL First Japan Tour 2012 -PLAYGIRLZ- (1080p HD)​



・ The final performance of AFTERSCHOOL's first Japan Tour, "AFTERSCHOOL First Japan Tour 2012 -PLAYGIRLZ-," held in the spring of 2012, at Osaka Namba Hatch!!!
・ All tickets were sold out for all performances, and the premium live performance, which was broadcast live on Ustream, was accessed by over 30,000 viewers, and this Blu-ray captures that experience!!!
・ In addition, as bonus footage, the Blu-ray will also include AFTERSCHOOL RED's special performance by leader Kahi, who graduated from the group after this tour, as well as her solo performance and the emotional final performance by all the members!!!
